queue.what: Provides landed-cost calculation (duties, taxes, fees), HS classification and a landed-cost guarantee that includes tax remittance, for cross-border e-commerce checkouts and shipments.

Tax-compliance software company whose AvaTax Cross-Border product calculates duties, import taxes and landed cost at checkout, and which powers duty and import-tax features in Shopify Markets and eBay
Cross-border direct-to-consumer e-commerce enabler (localized checkout, duty and tax compliance, shipping and returns) with a New York office, owned by Asendia.
